OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On
            output it is the composed address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same way (upper-cased,
            whitespace-collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. a unit or suite). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 2'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional; when present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner, exactly 4 digits. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed city-to-region postcode table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. It is stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and the same postcode (the same household). It only bypasses
            the household-duplicate block; the owner is created as a declared household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; it is used
            only at creation time and is neither stored nor returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A generated customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the
                first 8 upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A generated membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year
                (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, the score the membershipLevel is
                derived from. Starts at 0 and gains 2 when an email address is
                present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2
                for a household of 3 or more members (householdSize is at least
                3), and 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds 365 days. A newly
                created owner (zero tenure) is never awarded the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from the
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points,
                level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region component of the customer code (the text before the
                first '-'), the region derived from the postcode (falling back to
                the fixed city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD); 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Null when the
                region is not one of these.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate as at the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On
            output it is the composed address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same way (upper-cased,
            whitespace-collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. a unit or suite). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 2'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional; when present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner, exactly 4 digits. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed city-to-region postcode table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. It is stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and the same postcode (the same household). It only bypasses
            the household-duplicate block; the owner is created as a declared household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; it is used
            only at creation time and is neither stored nor returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A generated customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the
                first 8 upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A generated membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year
                (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, the score the membershipLevel is
                derived from. Starts at 0 and gains 2 when an email address is
                present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2
                for a household of 3 or more members (householdSize is at least
                3), and 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds 365 days. A newly
                created owner (zero tenure) is never awarded the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from the
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points,
                level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region component of the customer code (the text before the
                first '-'), the region derived from the postcode (falling back to
                the fixed city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD); 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Null when the
                region is not one of these.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate as at the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier: the first 12 hex characters of the
                SHA-256 of 'normalizedLastName|postcode'. Owners with the same last name
                and postcode are the same household and automatically carry the same value.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A1B7C9D4E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value used for duplicate detection, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (an absent email or household id
                contributes an empty string). A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only
                when a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because
                the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1B7C9D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

                already been created on the same day (by registration date). True once
                the day's count exceeds 80, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:

                shares an existing owner's last name and postcode while having a different
                normalized telephone. True for such a soft match, otherwise false.
              type: boolean

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS',
            'MS' or 'DR'. When present it is stored and returned, and is used to
            compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On
            output it is the composed address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same way (upper-cased,
            whitespace-collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. a unit or suite). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 2'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional; when present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner, exactly 4 digits. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed city-to-region postcode table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. It is stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and the same postcode (the same household). It only bypasses
            the household-duplicate block; the owner is created as a declared household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; it is used
            only at creation time and is neither stored nor returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A generated customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the
                first 8 upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A generated membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year
                (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, the score the membershipLevel is
                derived from. Starts at 0 and gains 2 when an email address is
                present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2
                for a household of 3 or more members (householdSize is at least
                3), and 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds 365 days. A newly
                created owner (zero tenure) is never awarded the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from the
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points,
                level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region component of the customer code (the text before the
                first '-'), the region derived from the postcode (falling back to
                the fixed city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD); 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Null when the
                region is not one of these.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate as at the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier: the first 12 hex characters of the
                SHA-256 of 'normalizedLastName|postcode'. Owners with the same last name
                and postcode are the same household and automatically carry the same value.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A1B7C9D4E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value used for duplicate detection, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (an absent email or household id
                contributes an empty string). A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only
                when a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because
                the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1B7C9D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created on the same day (by registration date). True once
                the day's count exceeds 80, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, it was a soft match for an
                existing owner: not a hard duplicate (its identity key is unique) but it
                shares an existing owner's last name and postcode while having a different
                normalized telephone. True for such a soft match, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a soft match for (see
                'possibleDuplicate'); null when it is not a possible duplicate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

        firstName:

        lastName:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On
            output it is the composed address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same way (upper-cased,
            whitespace-collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. a unit or suite). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 2'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional; when present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner, exactly 4 digits. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed city-to-region postcode table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. It is stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'

            same last name and the same postcode (the same household). It only bypasses
            the household-duplicate block; the owner is created as a declared household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; it is used
            only at creation time and is neither stored nor returned.

          writeOnly: true
          example: false

              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A generated customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where

                first 8 upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest of the

              type: string

            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points

                derived from. Starts at 0 and gains 2 when an email address is
                present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2
                for a household of 3 or more members (householdSize is at least
                3), and 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds 365 days. A newly
                created owner (zero tenure) is never awarded the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-

                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points,
                level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region component of the customer code (the text before the
                first '-'), the region derived from the postcode (falling back to
                the fixed city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD); 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Null when the
                region is not one of these.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate as at the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:

                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier: the first 12 hex characters of the
                SHA-256 of 'normalizedLastName|postcode'. Owners with the same last name
                and postcode are the same household and automatically carry the same value.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A1B7C9D4E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-

                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (an absent email or household id

                when a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because
                the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1B7C9D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created on the same day (by registration date). True once
                the day's count exceeds 80, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:

              type: boolean

            possibleDuplicateOf:

                'possibleDuplicate'); null when it is not a possible duplicate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

Implemented the `salutation` feature for pet owners end-to-end, following the existing Spring/OpenAPI conventions in this codebase (derived fields are computed on the `Owner` entity and surfaced via the MapStruct `OwnerMapper`, with input/output fields declared in `openapi.yml` from which the DTOs are generated).

**Changes:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`**
   - Added an optional `title` input field to the `OwnerFields` schema (string, documented as `MR`/`MRS`/`MS`/`DR`) — stored and returned.
   - Added a read-only `salutation` derived field to the `Owner` schema.

2. **`src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java`**
   - Added the `title` column (`@Column(name = "title")`) with getter/setter.
   - Added `getSalutation()`: returns `title + " " + lastName` when a title is present, otherwise just `lastName`.

3. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`**
   - Mapped `salutation` via `owner.getSalutation()` in `toOwnerDto`. (`title` maps automatically by name on both read and write.)

4. **DB schemas** (`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`)
   - Added the `title` column to the `owners` table. Seed-data inserts use explicit column lists, so they were unaffected.

**Tests:** `AcceptanceTest.coreComposesSalutation` passes (posting `title=DR`, `lastName=who` yields `salutation` = `"DR who"`), and the full suite builds green.
